subject: planner: LEADING hint works with non-equijoin + outer join (#66213)
summary: Reviewed join reorder changes in `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go` and `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder_greedy.go`: LEADING can now connect nodes via non-equality predicates under outer-join groups, with a conservative safety guard that excludes predicates referencing null-extended columns. No plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in this commit relative to its first parent.
